name: manager-mcp
description: MCP server for Manager.io bookkeeping: read-first with opt-in scoped task and write tools.

MANAGER_API_URL.title: Manager API URL
MANAGER_API_URL.description: Instance root including /api2 when required (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:55667/api2).

MANAGER_API_KEY.title: Manager API key
MANAGER_API_KEY.description: Access token from Manager Settings → Access Tokens (sent as X-API-KEY).

MANAGER_MCP_WRITE_SCOPES.title: Write scopes
MANAGER_MCP_WRITE_SCOPES.description: Comma-separated domains for create/update: quotes,orders,parties,items,sales,purchases,banking,payroll,ledger,raw. Recommended: banking,sales,parties. Empty = read-only.

MANAGER_MCP_DELETE_SCOPES.title: Delete scopes
MANAGER_MCP_DELETE_SCOPES.description: Comma-separated domains for delete only. Never implied by write scopes. Empty = no deletes.
